title: Easy Elegant Argentinian Smoked Mackerel Empanadas
description: A winey and glassy-jelly weeknight Argentinian dish featuring smoked mackerel, perfect for a ferment and dash friendly meal, this empanada is a twist on traditional recipes.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a bowl, mix together the smoked mackerel, onion, and red wine.
Roll out the empanada dough to a thickness of about 1/8 inch.
Cut out circles of dough using a cookie cutter or the rim of a glass.
Place a tablespoon of the mackerel mixture onto the center of each dough circle.
Brush the edges of the dough with the beaten egg for a golden glaze.
Fold the dough in half over the filling, pressing the edges together to seal the empanada.
Brush the tops of the empanadas with olive oil and sprinkle with salt and pepper.
Place the empanadas on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and bake for 20 minutes.
